tagline: From raw stone to lasting value
description: ROUGH is an independent magazine about rough gems, precious stones, cutting, jewelry and men's style with character: rigorous guides, without investment promises or made-up prices.

gemas-en-bruto.name: Gems in the rough
gemas-en-bruto.description: Minerals and deposits from Spain, from Navajún pyrite to Asturian fluorite and jet: how to recognize them, conserve them and collect them responsibly.

piedras-preciosas.name: gemstones
piedras-preciosas.description: Ruby, sapphire, spinel, garnets, tourmaline and alexandrite: quality, treatments, synthetics, imitations and gemological instruments.

talla-y-joyeria.name: Carving and jewelry
talla-y-joyeria.description: Cabochon, faceting, casting, filigree, damascening, enamels and hallmarks: the crafts that turn stone and metal into a well-made jewel.

compra-y-valoracion.name: Purchase and evaluation
compra-y-valoracion.description: Buy, appraise, sell and claim judiciously in Spain: jewelry stores, online purchases, auctions, sale of gold, vintage jewelry and guarantees.

estilo-masculino.name: Men's style
estilo-masculino.description: Durable clothing, boots, leather, watches and rings: a wardrobe with character that is built with a few good pieces.

cuidado-personal.name: Personal care
cuidado-personal.description: Shaving, beard, skin, hair, hands and fragrance explained sensibly, without miracle promises or impossible routines.
